question: India participated in the 9th BRICS Industry Ministers' Meeting held on 21 May 2025, under the Chairmanship of which country?
solution: The correct answer is __**Brazil**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The 9th BRICS Industry Ministers' Meeting was held on **21 May 2025**, under the chairmanship of **Brazil**. • **BRICS** is a grouping of five major emerging economies: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, established to promote economic, political, and cultural cooperation. • The meeting focused on strengthening industrial development, cooperation, and innovation among BRICS nations. • **India**, being a member of BRICS, actively participated to discuss various global and regional issues, particularly emphasizing sustainable industrial growth and development. • Brazil held the chairmanship of BRICS for the year 2025, leading the agenda of the meeting and hosting the event.
